LanguageData.NAT_Setting_EndingExpansionsChance_Desc: Chance factor for modded entity waves on Anomaly ending. Final chance is aslo affected by count of modded waves existing, so if you have only one modded chance would much lower compared to 5 for example.
LanguageData.NAT_Setting_AllowDiscoveredEntitiesIncre: Adjust count of discovered entities required to upgrade monolith to next level.
